tools.name: agent_get_state
tools.title: Get MCMCP State
tools.description: Returns the latest immutable, policy-filtered client state and the latest observation-frame summary. control.granted_capabilities reports the current local lease; entity_attack_consent reports none/pending/granted local consent and exposes its short-lived ref only after a physical primary click on the dedicated local confirmation screen. It does not itself register consent or add a Tool. policy.action_dsl exposes all available opcode descriptors, opaque-reference refresh contracts, and machine-readable MISSING_CAPABILITY guidance without adding another Tool. Pass no arguments for state only. To search client-known recipe displays, use {"query":{"kind":"result_item","item":"minecraft:stick"},"max_results":16} or {"query":{"kind":"result_tag","tag":"minecraft:planks"},"max_results":16}; the bounded result appears in recipe_query. inventory keeps item-ID totals; standard_potions separately validates component-exact unmodified Vanilla singleton potion stacks and groups them by item+potion across inventory slots, so brewing inputs and outputs are distinguishable without exposing custom components or impossible overstacks. merchant_offers is present only while the exact current merchant screen has a fresh same-session/container/open-revision server packet; it exposes typed item/count facts and registered stored-enchantment IDs+levels, never raw slots, components, NBT, lore, or display text. known_menu is present only for an exact current server-synchronized accepted Menu profile: Vanilla generic_9x1..9x6, or the version/hash/class-fixed Sophisticated Backpacks 3.25.90 normal backpack storage profile. Copy one single-use operation_ref into operate_known_menu and never infer raw slots or GUI coordinates; valid_through_client_tick is only the outer deadline and any exact-menu context change invalidates it earlier. Open upgrade/extra slots, inaccessible or oversized stacks, and insufficient full-stack capacity are omitted. With continuous visual invalidations, a bounded full-direction catch-up completes a fresh frame within twice the normal scan period (16 active ticks at the default setting), without camera input or stale-ray reuse. Calling this announces observation.latest_frame_id with a 60-second idle lifetime; at most 16 announced handles are retained, so an older handle may be evicted sooner. Recipe data comes only from displays synchronized into the current client recipe book. It never scans hidden world data.

ready_expires_at.description: Schema v1 compatibility field; always null because READY does not expire

standard_potions.description: Own-inventory projection only. Validates component-exact unmodified Vanilla singleton potion stacks, then groups them by item+potion across slots; impossible overstacks, custom color/effects/name/lore, or any other nonstandard component are omitted rather than exposed.

entity_attack_consent.description: Read-only summary of one runtime-owned bounded kill-zone consent. Pending is never attack authority. MCP 2026-07-28 clients declaring form elicitation receive client-side input_required approval with no Minecraft prompt or consent input lock; unsupported clients fall back to the local physical Grant screen and a 3600-tick (3-minute), single-consume start token. Each path is bound to exactly one finite operate_kill_zone Action, not one entity and not a reusable cross-Action lease. The Action-owned duration starts only after approval consumption and is capped at 35990 ticks; sustained jobs should normally request at least 3600 ticks or a potion/equipment window. Current targets and newly spawned mobs matching the approved types may be attacked until the finite count, operation deadline, or a hard safety gate ends the Action. Per-target entity_ref is deliberately excluded. The consumer JIT proves fresh target, whole AABB containment, LOS, reach, crosshair, cooldown, structure, collateral safety, and effective health before every dispatch. Decline, cancel, Esc/emergency stop, OFF, world/session change, endpoint fault, shutdown, or effective-health decrease revokes authority.

merchant_offers.description: Optional exact-current-screen projection. Omitted unless the visible MerchantScreen, player menu, world session, container ID, and open-packet revision all match the latest inbound merchant-offers packet.

max_distance_blocks.description: Public Action distance-budget hard maximum. Route search separately reserves bounded start-pose uncertainty before admitting a path.

latest_frame_id.description: Handle announced by agent_get_state; retained for up to 60 idle seconds subject to the 16-handle cap

visible_surface.description: Number of deliverable unique visible block positions after representative-face compaction

tools.name: agent_get_observation
tools.title: Get MCMCP Observation
tools.description: Returns a stable, paged projection of one policy-filtered omnidirectional frame; it accepts no arbitrary center or radius. Ask for one purpose at a time: crop/chest/gate=visible_surface, drops or item-frame labels=visible_entity, route=traversability. Use optional filter to return only relevant block_ids, faces, entity_types, displayed_items, crop_mature, or one inclusive position_bounds; filters applicable to a record kind are ANDed and only remove already-policy-visible records, so they cannot weaken safety evidence or expose hidden state. Query labels with entity_types=["minecraft:item_frame","minecraft:glow_item_frame"]; a non-empty frame directly attached to a policy-visible single chest/barrel face may include container_label. displayed_items remains exclusive to dropped minecraft:item entities. faces filters visible_surface before the one-face-per-position representative is selected. position_bounds anchors visible_surface at position, visible_entity/hazard/unknown_boundary/sound_clue at floor(position), and traversability at navigation_target. For harvest use {block_ids:["minecraft:wheat"],crop_mature:true}; for drops use {entity_types:["minecraft:item"],displayed_items:["minecraft:wheat","minecraft:wheat_seeds"]}. visible_surface is one representative face per block position and is ordered mature crop, immature crop, then other surfaces, near-first. Every visible_surface includes required nullable state, placement_item, and placement_state_ref fields. state is complete only for the closed construction copy/support and furnace-family target allowlist, plus exact source water used as a fishing cast witness; non-source water and all other blocks remain null so non-rendered properties never cross the visual boundary. A non-null placement_item has a non-null state and session-scoped opaque placement_state_ref. The ref becomes usable only after successful response delivery, survives the 60-second coordinate-evidence TTL, and is cleared at the world-session boundary; target/support/pose evidence remains current and JIT-checked. Use the smallest useful limit. If next_cursor is non-null, either continue that exact frame/kinds/filter query immediately or allow its bounded 60-second lease to expire; abandoning two paged queries makes a third root query SERVER_BUSY. Only static visible_surface coordinate records actually returned may remain planner-usable for at most 60 seconds; dynamic records, including container labels, are never extended. On FRAME_EXPIRED, call agent_get_state and retry with observation.latest_frame_id.

positionBounds.description: One inclusive integer block-coordinate box in one dimension. This is a delivery-only filter over the selected frame, not an observation center or radius.

completeBlockState.description: Complete registered runtime BlockState. properties contains every property defined by block; property-free blocks use an empty object.

worldBounds.description: Ordered continuous AABB in one dimension; runtime additionally limits each axis span to 64 blocks.

visibleSurface.description: One deterministic representative visible face for this block position; UP is preferred over horizontal faces, which are preferred over DOWN. state is the complete runtime BlockState only for the closed construction copy/support and furnace-family target allowlist (copyable blocks plus minecraft:dirt, minecraft:grass_block, minecraft:obsidian, minecraft:furnace, minecraft:blast_furnace, and minecraft:smoker), and null otherwise so hidden properties are not disclosed. placement_item is the ordinary inventory item that may reproduce a non-null state through the closed placement adapter. placement_state_ref is its bounded, session-local opaque memory identity; it is null when the surface is not eligible for safe copy placement.

entity_ref.description: Nullable for players or when safe issuance failed. A non-null value is a 24-character opaque reference issued only from this current visual entity sample. It is bound server-side to the exact world session, dimension, registry type, and internal entity identity, resolves for at most 100 client ticks after the latest visible observation, and never exposes the UUID. Reobserve after expiry; the ref alone never proves current visibility or authorizes an operation.

displayed_item.description: Present only for a visible minecraft:item entity; registry identity of its rendered non-empty ItemStack. Stack count, components, UUID, owner, pickup delay, and age are intentionally omitted.

frame_display.description: Present only when the front display face of a Vanilla item_frame or glow_item_frame is currently visible under fog and LOS policy. item is null for an observed empty frame; absence of frame_display means unknown, never empty. rotation is the rendered 0..7 rotation. aim_point is the witnessed front-face point. This works independently of container_label, including frames near double chests. Copy entity_ref and the expected item into the frame-item Action; reobserve between removal, pickup, and insertion.

container_label.description: Present only for a visible non-empty minecraft:item_frame or minecraft:glow_item_frame directly attached to one policy-visible single chest or barrel face. It links the rendered registry item to the exact container block without exposing count, components, NBT, or UUID. Double chests are omitted in this initial slice. Copy the record entity_ref and container_label.item into routing_label; the runtime rechecks the same visible frame, item, attachment, and target before every open or transfer click.

navigation_target.description: Exact integer player feet-space cell accepted by navigate_to_known.target; copy without rounding from/to. A standalone navigation to a freshly returned target is distance-admissible with the public maximum max_distance_blocks=32 when the starting pose remains inside its bounded cell envelope.

tools.name: agent_start_action
tools.title: Start MCMCP Action
tools.description: Runs one validated Action DSL v1 program while in-game MCP operation is enabled. Choose Action boundaries from current evidence: combine nodes only when every later node is admissible now or has an explicitly supported dependency proof. Batch 2..8 targets within one crop stage; when a mutation creates new drops or newly exposed surfaces, finish, reobserve, then start the next Action. apply_known_block_plan is the bounded exception for explicitly declared earlier-entry placement dependencies. Put wait_until immediately after its plant node when growth must be awaited. Copy traversability.navigation_target verbatim into navigate_to_known.target; never derive, floor, round, or copy continuous traversability.from/to coordinates. When you have a visible block but no safe feet coordinate, copy visible_surface.position and block verbatim into approach_known_surface; the runtime selects a known interaction-range navigation cell, then finish the Action and reobserve before mutation. For a later stationary dry bottom oak/cobblestone stair plan whose directional placement context is not reachable from the current pose, copy the same anchor/transform/entries into the movement-only approach_known_placement; entries require placement_state_ref plus current UP support expected_state, and the node must be the only top-level node. It selects one known stand cell for every entry, then finish and reobserve before apply_known_block_plan. collect_visible_item and collect_visible_item_batch targets are the only continuous positions: copy visible_entity.position and displayed_item without rounding. Use collect_visible_item_batch for 2..8 current drops instead of one Action per item. For building copy, use only visible_surface records whose placement_item is non-null: prefer placement_state_ref, or copy state verbatim into source_state and placement_item into item. For construction clear, copy the complete current target state into expected_before; after terminal fresh-air verification, reobserve before a separate apply_known_block_plan replacement Action. Never convert state properties yourself. Construction requires every support to be within 40 total yaw+pitch degrees of the admitted heading; when it is not, copy one unexpired delivered visible support's position, face, and block verbatim into face_known_block_face immediately before the plan, or split the plan. This camera-only recovery can use older evidence within its TTL; every later mutation separately requires current evidence. For crafting, query agent_get_state recipes first, copy one current recipe_ref and fingerprint into craft_known_recipe.recipe_ref and recipe_fingerprint, and use one current visible minecraft:crafting_table. For smelting, copy one current furnace-family recipe_ref and fingerprint, the visible station state, and one default-component fuel into smelt_known_recipe, and set max_smelts to the exact current input-stack count 1..64; this exact-stack node must be the final top-level node outside if/repeat. For a known Menu operation, copy one current operation_ref into operate_known_menu; this node must be the final top-level node outside if/repeat. For brewing, use own-inventory standard_potions evidence and one current visible minecraft:brewing_stand; brew_known_potion_batch accepts one catalog-fixed standard Vanilla one-step recipe for 1..3 bottles and must be the final top-level node outside if/repeat. For an exact generic break, copy target, face, and complete expected_state from one current visible_surface into break_known_block; only the catalog-declared block/tool/drop triples are accepted, success also requires expected_drop inventory growth to minimum_inventory_count, and repeat is forbidden. For Redstone, apply_known_redstone_spec supports only the stationary one-lever identity slices declared by its schema: one direct lamp, the fixed two-lamp fan-out, or the fixed one-dust straight identity; the straight-wire slice requires current visible minecraft:glass UP supports under its lamp, dust, and lever; do not infer variable-length or bent wire or arbitrary logic. The envelope is {schema_version:1,program:{dsl_version:1,name?:string,capabilities:string[],body:node[]},budget:{max_duration_ms,max_ticks,max_distance_blocks,max_camera_degrees,max_interactions,max_blocks_broken,max_blocks_placed}}. Every node needs a unique id matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ and one exact op. Non-pausing ChatScreen does not block world actions or bounded input holds; pause, overlays, other unexpected screens and exact owned-container requirements still apply. hold_bounded_inputs:{id,op,inputs,duration_ticks,target_guard?,selected_item?} is the only top-level node; movement-only inputs omit target_guard and selected_item. Frequent exact signatures are navigate_to_known:{id,op,target,tolerance}; approach_known_surface:{id,op,target,expected_block}; approach_known_placement:{id,op,anchor,transform:{rotation,mirror},entries:[{id,offset,placement_state_ref,support:{position,face,expected_state,dependency_entry_id}}]}; face_known_block_face:{id,op,target,face,expected_block}; break_known_block:{id,op,target,face,expected_state,tool_item,expected_drop,minimum_inventory_count}; operate_known_cobblestone_generator:{id,op,target,face,expected_state,tool_item,expected_drop,minimum_inventory_count,max_breaks,regeneration_wait_ticks,max_operation_duration_ticks}; open_known_passage/inspect_known_container:{id,op,target,expected_block}; take_known_container_stack:{id,op,target,expected_block,item,stack_policy,minimum_inventory_count}; store_known_container_stack:{id,op,target,expected_block,item,stack_policy,minimum_container_count}; craft_known_recipe:{id,op,recipe_ref,recipe_fingerprint,goal:{item,stack_policy,minimum_inventory_count},station:{kind,target,expected_state},max_crafts}; smelt_known_recipe:{id,op,recipe_ref,recipe_fingerprint,goal:{item,stack_policy,minimum_inventory_count},station:{kind,target,expected_state},fuel:{item,stack_policy},max_smelts}; operate_known_menu:{id,op,operation_ref}; brew_known_potion_batch:{id,op,target,expected_block,input:{item,potion,count},ingredient_item,fuel_item,expected_output:{item,potion,count}}; till_known_batch:{id,op,targets:[position],expected_block,hoe_item}; plant_known_wheat_batch:{id,op,targets:[{target,support}],seed_item}; harvest_known_wheat_batch:{id,op,targets:[position]}; apply_known_block_plan:{id,op,anchor,transform:{rotation,mirror},entries:[{id,offset,placement_state_ref,support:{position,face,expected_state,dependency_entry_id}}]}; clear_known_block_plan:{id,op,anchor,transform:{rotation,mirror},entries:[{id,offset,expected_before}]}; pillar_up_known:{id,op,support,expected_support,placement_state_ref}; apply_known_redstone_spec:{id,op,anchor,rotation,components:[{id,role,block}],truth_table:[{inputs:{input},outputs:{output}}],footprint:{x,y,z},timing:{settle_ticks}}; collect_visible_item_batch:{id,op,targets:[{displayed_item,target}]}; cast_known_fishing_rod:{id,op,hand,rod_item,target,face,expected_state}; reel_known_fishing_session:{id,op,fishing_session_ref,hand,rod_item}; operate_kill_zone:{id,op,target_kill_zone_bounds,entity_type_allowlist,main_hand_item,consent_ref,max_attacks,minimum_interval_ticks,max_operation_duration_ticks}. apply_known_block_plan entries and pillar_up_known each select placement_state_ref or legacy source_state plus item as an exact one-of. Both support.expected_state and support.dependency_entry_id are required nullable fields and exactly one must be non-null. Exact ops are navigate_to_known, approach_known_surface, approach_known_placement, face_known_position, face_known_block_face, break_known_face, break_known_block, operate_known_cobblestone_generator, till_known_block, till_known_batch, plant_known_wheat, plant_known_wheat_batch, harvest_known_wheat, harvest_known_wheat_batch, apply_known_block_plan, clear_known_block_plan, pillar_up_known, apply_known_redstone_spec, open_known_fence_gate, open_known_passage, inspect_known_container, take_known_container_stack, store_known_container_stack, remove_visible_frame_item, insert_visible_frame_item, craft_known_recipe, smelt_known_recipe, operate_known_menu, brew_known_potion_batch, collect_visible_item, collect_visible_item_batch, cast_known_fishing_rod, reel_known_fishing_session, operate_kill_zone, wait_ticks, wait_until, if, and repeat; use the exact inputSchema fields and no aliases. Required capabilities are navigate/approach_known_surface/approach_known_placement/collect=movement; face_known_position/face_known_block_face=camera; break/harvest/clear_known_block_plan=camera+block_break; operate_known_cobblestone_generator=block_break; till/open=camera+block_interact; plant/apply_known_block_plan=camera+block_place; pillar_up_known=movement+camera+block_place; apply_known_redstone_spec=camera+block_interact+block_place; operate_known_menu=inventory_transfer; cast_known_fishing_rod=camera+item_use; reel_known_fishing_session=item_use; operate_kill_zone=entity_attack; remove_visible_frame_item=camera+entity_attack; insert_visible_frame_item=camera+item_use; inspect/take/store/craft/smelt/brew=camera+inventory_transfer. For each frame operation reserve 20000 ms, 400 ticks, 360 camera degrees and 1 interaction, with zero movement/breaks/placements. It must be the only top-level node. Use a current front-visible frame_display witness; remove expected_item first, reobserve and collect its drop separately, then insert into the newly observed empty frame. Removal confirms display removal, not pickup; never retry an unknown frame attack or use without reobservation. The schema-wide 36000-tick and 1800000-ms maxima are accepted for one top-level operate_kill_zone or operate_known_cobblestone_generator; the 2048-interaction maximum remains kill-zone-only. Every other Action retains the 15000-tick, 750000-ms, and 16-interaction limits. For operate_known_cobblestone_generator set budget.max_ticks and budget.max_duration_ms to its max_operation_duration_ticks and 50 times that value, max_blocks_broken to max_breaks, and every movement, camera, interaction, and placement budget to zero. Prefer 3600..6000 ticks for ordinary runs; 36000 is the explicit hard maximum. For operate_kill_zone set budget.max_ticks to max_operation_duration_ticks+10, budget.max_duration_ms to 50 times that tick budget, max_interactions to max_attacks, and every motion, camera, break, and place budget to zero; the reserved final 10 ticks reconcile the last dispatched effect and do not authorize another attack. For cast_known_fishing_rod reserve 4000 ms, 80 ticks, its currently proved camera delta, and 2 interactions; for reel_known_fishing_session reserve 4000 ms, 80 ticks, and 2 interactions, with zero movement, camera, breaks, and placements. For each inspect/craft reserve at least 30000 ms, 600 ticks, 360 camera degrees, and its schema-stated interactions; craft reserves exactly 1+4*max_crafts interactions. For take/store reserve 600+60*(max_stacks-1) ticks, 50 times that in ms, 360 camera degrees, and 2+max_stacks interactions. Optional max_stacks defaults to 1 and is at most 14; max_transfer_count defaults to 64*max_stacks and is at most 896. They bound this batch, while minimum_inventory_count (up to 2304) or minimum_container_count (up to 3456) is an absolute destination goal. For operate_known_menu reserve at least 30000 ms, 600 ticks, and 1 interaction; distance, camera, breaks, and placements are zero. For smelt reserve 2200+200*max_smelts ticks, 50 times that many milliseconds, up to 540 camera degrees for aim plus view restoration, and 7 interactions. For brew reserve at least 70000 ms, 1400 ticks, up to 540 camera degrees for aim plus view restoration, and 16 interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero. For approach_known_placement reserve a normal navigation budget up to 30000 ms, 600 ticks, and 32 distance blocks with zero camera/interactions/breaks/placements. For each apply_known_block_plan entry reserve 15000 ms, 300 ticks, 80 camera degrees, and one placement; an 8-entry plan therefore needs 120000 ms, 2400 ticks, 640 camera degrees, and 8 placements with zero movement, interactions, and breaks. clear_known_block_plan uses the same per-entry time and camera bound with one break instead of one placement. For pillar_up_known reserve 15000 ms, 300 ticks, 2 distance blocks, 360 camera degrees, and one placement; interactions and breaks are zero. For apply_known_redstone_spec reserve 100*(component_count+2) + 3*settle_ticks ticks, 50 times that many milliseconds, 720 camera degrees, 2 interactions, and component_count placements; distance and breaks are zero. For another 8-target mutation batch, reserve 120000 ms, 2400 ticks, up to the 720 camera-degree policy maximum, and 8 interactions/breaks/placements as applicable. Targets always execute in submitted order; if that order costs more than 720 camera degrees, split it into smaller batches instead of reordering at runtime. take/store stack_policy is exactly default_components_only or item_id_any_components; craft/smelt goal.stack_policy and smelt fuel.stack_policy are exactly default_components_only. Use observed coordinates and policy maxima when unsure of an adequate budget. PROGRAM_BUDGET_UNPROVABLE reports all insufficient budget component names without echoing submitted values.

completeBlockState.description: Complete registered runtime BlockState copied without omission from visible_surface.state. Unknown, missing, duplicate, or invalid properties fail before input.

routingLabel.description: Optional routing-only witness copied from one current visible_entity with container_label. It never authorizes a transfer by itself; the exact referenced item frame, label item, direct attachment, container target, and LOS are rechecked before every click.

navigateNode.description: Copy traversability.navigation_target verbatim into target. Never derive, floor, round, or copy the continuous traversability.from/to coordinates.

approachKnownSurfaceNode.description: Copy one current visible_surface.position and block verbatim. The runtime chooses the shortest reachable policy-known feet cell whose geometric eye-to-block distance is within a conservative interaction envelope; it never derives or exposes hidden terrain. This node only approaches. End the Action, request a fresh observation from the new eye position, and only then submit a block interaction or mutation.

faceKnownBlockFaceNode.description: Turn only the camera toward the center of one exact face copied from an unexpired delivered visible_surface. Copy position into target, face, and block into expected_block verbatim. Admission and execution require the same world session, dimension, position, face, and block and reject future-revision evidence. This camera-only recovery may use older delivered evidence within its TTL; every later interaction or mutation separately requires current evidence and its own revision barriers.

breakKnownBlockNode.description: Break one exact currently visible complete BlockState using a closed audited block/tool/drop combination. Copy target, face, and expected_state verbatim from one current delivered visible_surface. V1 permits oak or birch logs with the matching log drop and an exact Vanilla axe, plus cobblestone with minecraft:iron_pickaxe and a cobblestone drop. The runtime rechecks the complete state and selected tool immediately before a finite attack lease; success requires a Vanilla prediction ACK, authoritative air, and a server-synchronized increase of expected_drop reaching minimum_inventory_count. This world mutation is forbidden inside repeat, so every next break requires fresh evidence.

operateKnownCobblestoneGeneratorNode.description: Operate one already-built cobblestone generator from a fixed pose and current exact face until the server-synchronized absolute inventory goal is reached. This node is top-level-only and never exposes raw mouse hold. It requires exact minecraft:cobblestone, minecraft:iron_pickaxe with max_breaks durability, and a cobblestone drop. Every cycle uses the existing short renewable attack lease, records one server-ACK plus authoritative-air checkpoint/effect, releases attack while waiting for regeneration, and reproves exact state/face/reach/tool before the next lease. max_breaks and max_operation_duration_ticks are independent hard stops. Use 3600..6000 ticks for an ordinary 3..5 minute run; the explicit maximum is 36000 ticks (30 minutes). Esc/emergency stop, OFF, health or control-context change, unexpected screen, world/session change, or safety change releases input and terminates.

holdBoundedInputsNode.description: hold_bounded_inputs holds one closed set of semantic Minecraft inputs for a finite duration, as the only top-level Action node. inputs is duplicate-free. Movement inputs require movement; attack requires block_break; use requires item_use. An attack/use hold must copy one fresh visible_surface position, face, and complete state into target_guard and declare the exact currently selected item. The runtime reproves that exact crosshair target/state/face and selected item before acquiring input and throughout the hold; any mismatch, blocking non-chat screen, overlay, pause, OFF, emergency stop, cancellation, world/session change, health or safety interruption releases every held input before terminal. Non-pausing ChatScreen is allowed and its text is not read or submitted. Movement-only holds forbid target_guard and selected_item. The 1,728,000-tick maximum is 24 hours; prefer the shortest duration that completes the requested stationary job.

tillBatchNode.description: Till 1..8 distinct currently visible blocks in the submitted target order. Every target uses the same expected_block and hoe_item. Each target reserves and performs at most 40 active ticks of fresh reproof immediately before use; current plus the complete unstarted suffix must still fit before dispatch. The batch never reorders or skips targets and fails without continuing if any target cannot be exactly aimed, reproved, or server-confirmed; admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]. Passive, input-neutral 1/16-block farmland settling is audited separately from input distance.

targets.description: Admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]

plantWheatBatchNode.description: Plant 1..8 distinct wheat plots in the submitted target order. Each entry declares the crop target and its farmland support. Every support reserves and performs at most 40 active ticks of fresh reproof; current plus the complete unstarted suffix must fit before dispatch. The batch never reorders or skips targets and fails without continuing if any target cannot be exactly aimed, reproved, or completed.

targets.description: Admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]

harvestWheatBatchNode.description: Harvest 1..8 distinct currently mature wheat blocks in the submitted target order. Every target reserves and performs at most 40 active ticks of fresh reproof; current plus the complete unstarted suffix must fit before dispatch. The batch never reorders or skips targets and fails without continuing if any target cannot be exactly aimed, reproved, or completed.

targets.description: Admission TARGET_UNKNOWN identifies the first failing entry as target[index]

blockPlanTransform.description: Mirror is applied first (x=FRONT_BACK/east-west reversal; z=LEFT_RIGHT/north-south reversal), then clockwise Y rotation.

blockPlanSupport.description: The target must be exactly one block beyond position in face direction. Select exactly one witness: copy a current visible_surface.state into expected_state and set dependency_entry_id to null, or set expected_state to null and name an earlier entry whose transformed target exactly equals position. Existing supports are accepted only when placement_item is non-null or block is minecraft:dirt, minecraft:grass_block, or minecraft:obsidian.

source_state.description: Copy one eligible source visible_surface.state verbatim. The runtime transforms this complete state with Minecraft mirror/rotation rules; do not rewrite facing, axis, rotation, shape, or other properties.

item.description: Copy the same source visible_surface.placement_item; null sources are not eligible entries.

placement_state_ref.description: Opaque session-local identity copied from one eligible visible_surface. It replaces source_state plus item and does not extend target/support/pose evidence.

approachKnownPlacementSupport.description: Copy one current complete support state directly below the transformed target. This first slice accepts only the UP face, requires expected_state, and forbids an earlier-entry dependency because the approach Action does not place blocks.

placement_state_ref.description: Copy an opaque placement_state_ref for a dry bottom oak or cobblestone stair. Inline source_state plus item is not accepted by this approach slice.

approachKnownPlacementNode.description: Movement-only placement-context approach for one later stationary stair plan. It resolves 1..8 dry bottom oak/cobblestone stair placement_state_ref values, applies the same mirror then clockwise Y rotation as apply_known_block_plan, and deterministically selects one policy-known stand cell whose current known route, settlement error, normal reach, support ray, and resulting horizontal placement direction satisfy every entry. It does not aim, place, or extend support evidence. This must be the only top-level node; after terminal, reobserve before submitting the later apply_known_block_plan. Reserve a normal navigation budget up to 30000 ms, 600 ticks, 32 distance blocks, and zero camera/interactions/breaks/placements.

applyKnownBlockPlanNode.description: Stationary place-only Phase 3 vertical slice for 1..8 ordered entries. Each transformed target is anchor plus offset after mirror (none/x/z) then clockwise Y rotation (0/90/180/270); transformed targets and entry ids must be unique. Each entry selects exactly one source identity: legacy source_state plus item copied verbatim from a currently retained eligible visible_surface, or placement_state_ref copied from an eligible surface delivered in this world session. A ref removes only the need to revisit the source coordinate; every target, support, aim, pose, policy, and packet-adjacent check remains current. The runtime applies Minecraft's BlockState mirror/rotation rules, so the policy never converts directional properties. Each entry uses either a current complete support-state witness or an explicit earlier-entry dependency. Every support aim uses the declared face center, not an incidental observation ray endpoint, and must be within 40 total yaw+pitch degrees of the admitted heading; use a preceding face_known_block_face copied from that delivered support or a smaller plan when necessary. A closed unpowered minecraft:oak_door uses only its lower-half source as one entry; do not submit the upper half. The runtime owns and separately server-verifies the derived upper cell, and that door entry costs two max_blocks_placed. Admission resolves a valid ref to its exact ordinary=1 or oak-door=2 placement footprint; an unresolved ref is conservatively costed as two and rejected by the budget or planner. An entry already at its exact transformed expected-after state is adopted without input or placement budget, but success still requires a later fresh exact verification of every entry. No movement, breaking, replacement, hidden scan, NBT, fluid, gravity block, container, portal, or command block is admitted. Execution is fail-fast, never reorders entries, and requires authoritative placement postconditions. Reserve 15000 ms, 300 ticks, 80 camera degrees, and one max_blocks_placed per ordinary entry or two for the oak-door entry; distance, interactions, and breaks are zero.

expected_before.description: Copy the complete current visible_surface.state for the block to clear. Runtime applies the declared mirror/rotation before checking the transformed target; partial states are rejected.

clearKnownBlockPlanNode.description: Stationary break-only construction slice for 1..8 ordered entries. Every transformed target must have a currently delivered visible_surface with non-null placement_item and an exact complete transformed expected_before admitted by the same safe full-block construction policy as apply_known_block_plan. Aim admission uses the delivered representative face center rather than its incidental observation ray endpoint. Runtime uses the existing authoritative BREAK_TO_AIR adapter, never moves or collects drops, and requires a later fresh exact air observation of every target before success. Replacement is a separate Action after reobservation, using apply_known_block_plan. Reserve 15000 ms, 300 ticks, 80 camera degrees, and one max_blocks_broken per entry; distance, interactions, and placements are zero.

pillarUpKnownNode.description: Exclusive one-block vertical primitive. support and expected_support must copy an exact delivered inert UP face before the final centering step; that witness alone may remain usable through the bounded delivery lease because the centered player occludes the block below, while runtime rechecks current position, world revision, and the complete live support state before input. The player must then be grounded and centered within 0.15 blocks directly above it. Select exactly one source identity: placement_state_ref from one successfully delivered eligible visible_surface, or legacy source_state plus item copied verbatim from that surface. The session-local ref survives the 60-second coordinate evidence TTL and removes only source reobservation; target, support, pose, JIT, and packet-adjacent checks remain current. Only one ordinary full collision block is allowed; doors and every multi-cell or partial-shape state are rejected. Runtime derives the air target at support+1 and the landing at support+2, rejects unknown, fluid, occupied, hazardous, unsupported, or obstructed cells, jumps, and dispatches exactly one use only after the player AABB clears the target. Success requires authoritative exact block confirmation, synchronized inventory -1, and grounded Y+1. It must be the only top-level Action node and is forbidden in if/repeat. Reserve 15000 ms, 300 ticks, 2 distance blocks, 360 camera degrees, one placement, and zero interactions/breaks.

applyKnownRedstoneSpecNode.description: Closed stationary Phase 5 identity slices only. anchor is the first redstone lamp target. The direct slice places its lever at rotation offset +1 with a 2x1x1 footprint. The fan-out slice places the lever at +1 and output_2 lamp at +2 with a 3x1x1 footprint. The straight-wire slice places one minecraft:redstone_wire at +1 and the lever at +2 with a 3x1x1 footprint; all three UP supports must be current visible minecraft:glass. Runtime confirms OFF, ON, and OFF as same-client-tick live sets, and the wire slice additionally requires the exact straight wire shape with power 0, 15, and 0. It never moves, breaks, admits variable-length or bent wire, combines wire with fan-out, or admits NOT/repeater/arbitrary circuits. Reserve 100*(component_count+2) + 3*settle_ticks ticks, 50 times that many milliseconds, 720 camera degrees, 2 interactions, and component_count placements; distance and breaks are zero.

openPassageNode.description: Open one currently visible allowlisted wooden door, trapdoor, or fence gate. A door succeeds only after both halves are authoritatively open.

inspectContainerNode.description: Open one visible in-reach vanilla chest/barrel and return up to 27 server-synchronized item counts in NODE_EVIDENCE. routing_label is optional; when supplied, it must be copied from a current visible item-frame container_label and is rechecked before every open click. Reserve at least 600 ticks, 30000 ms, 360 camera degrees, and 1 interaction; this includes Action dispatch/JIT headroom around the bounded 400-tick container attempt. Opening always uses MAIN_HAND. It prefers a nonempty hotbar item whose NeoForge doesSneakBypassUse and onItemUseFirst implementations are the unchanged IItemExtension defaults false and PASS. An empty hotbar slot is used only when the offhand doesSneakBypassUse hook is also unchanged; an empty offhand is allowed. On an exact vanilla chest/barrel with normal non-sneaking use, useWithoutItem returns a consuming result before ItemStack.useOn can run, so ordinary block items, tools and stack components alone do not make the hand unsafe. A custom MAIN_HAND hook, or a custom offhand sneak-bypass hook with an empty MAIN_HAND, is rejected; offhand is never the interaction hand. If no candidate exists, safe_open_hand=no_side_effect_free_main_hand and remedy=prepare_plain_material_or_safe_mining_tool_in_hotbar explain the remedy. Prediction admission failure reports only prediction_bridge=unregistered|disabled|lifecycle_closed|attempt_limit.

removeVisibleFrameItemNode.description: Remove the currently displayed expected_item with one empty-hand attack. An empty hotbar slot is required. Success confirms that the frame is empty and alive, not that a drop was produced or collected. Reobserve and use collect_visible_item separately before inserting a replacement. Never attack an already empty frame. This must be the only top-level node, outside if/repeat. Copy entity_ref from one current visible Vanilla item_frame or glow_item_frame with frame_display. The runtime fixes that exact front aim point and rotation, requires a stationary player within 3 blocks and normal entity reach/crosshair, and dispatches at most one normal interaction. Reserve 400 ticks, 20000 ms, 360 camera degrees and 1 interaction; movement, breaks and placements are zero. Camera heading is retained and the selected hotbar slot is restored on cleanup. Fresh server item data, same frame body and unchanged rotation are required. An unknown result is not retried automatically; reobserve before another Action. Other players changing the same frame can still race the normal server interaction; there is no atomic compare-and-swap in this client-only protocol.

insertVisibleFrameItemNode.description: Insert one item from an existing matching hotbar stack into an observed empty frame. The item ID must have an unambiguous component variant in the hotbar. Success also confirms one item consumed from inventory. A nonempty frame is rejected so it is never intentionally rotated. This must be the only top-level node, outside if/repeat. Copy entity_ref from one current visible Vanilla item_frame or glow_item_frame with frame_display. The runtime fixes that exact front aim point and rotation, requires a stationary player within 3 blocks and normal entity reach/crosshair, and dispatches at most one normal interaction. Reserve 400 ticks, 20000 ms, 360 camera degrees and 1 interaction; movement, breaks and placements are zero. Camera heading is retained and the selected hotbar slot is restored on cleanup. Fresh server item data, same frame body and unchanged rotation are required. An unknown result is not retried automatically; reobserve before another Action. Other players changing the same frame can still race the normal server interaction; there is no atomic compare-and-swap in this client-only protocol.

takeContainerStackNode.description: From one visible in-reach vanilla chest/barrel to the player inventory. Move whole matching stacks in one owned menu, then close/reopen the same container once for full server readback. Optional max_stacks is 1..14 (default 1); optional max_transfer_count is 1..896 (default 64*max_stacks). These bound this operation, while the minimum count is an absolute destination goal. The source-slot plan is fixed at the initial synchronized snapshot; replenished stacks are never added. Each whole stack must fit both the remaining count budget and destination capacity. One normal QUICK_MOVE is followed by fresh server slot confirmation before another click. Unexpected item/component/slot changes stop the batch without blind retry; confirmed prefix and any unconfirmed final click are reported separately. Optional routing_label is rechecked before both opens and every transfer click. Reserve 600+60*(max_stacks-1) ticks, 50 times that in ms, 360 camera degrees, and 2+max_stacks interactions. The bounded container attempt uses 400+60*(max_stacks-1) ticks, leaving 200 ticks for Action dispatch/JIT/release. Opening always uses MAIN_HAND and prefers a nonempty hotbar item whose NeoForge doesSneakBypassUse and onItemUseFirst implementations are the unchanged IItemExtension defaults false and PASS. An empty hotbar slot is used only when the offhand doesSneakBypassUse hook is also unchanged; an empty offhand is allowed. On the exact normal-use vanilla container, useWithoutItem returns a consuming result before ItemStack.useOn can run, so ordinary block items, tools and stack components alone remain safe. This keeps a cobblestone-filled opening slot usable without an extra interaction. A custom MAIN_HAND hook, or a custom offhand sneak-bypass hook with an empty MAIN_HAND, is rejected; offhand is never the interaction hand. If an empty opening slot could receive the requested item, that item must meet the same hook conditions before the first transfer click. If no candidate exists, safe_open_hand=no_side_effect_free_main_hand and remedy=prepare_plain_material_or_safe_mining_tool_in_hotbar explain the remedy. Prediction admission failure reports only prediction_bridge=unregistered|disabled|lifecycle_closed|attempt_limit.

minimum_inventory_count.description: Absolute player-inventory lower bound, not an exact transfer amount. Whole-stack limits can leave a confirmed prefix and then fail with TRANSFER_BATCH_GOAL_NOT_REACHED.

max_transfer_count.description: Ceiling for this whole-stack batch. Stacks are never split to fill the remaining budget.

storeContainerStackNode.description: From the player inventory to one visible in-reach vanilla chest/barrel. Move whole matching stacks in one owned menu, then close/reopen the same container once for full server readback. Optional max_stacks is 1..14 (default 1); optional max_transfer_count is 1..896 (default 64*max_stacks). These bound this operation, while the minimum count is an absolute destination goal. The source-slot plan is fixed at the initial synchronized snapshot; replenished stacks are never added. Each whole stack must fit both the remaining count budget and destination capacity. One normal QUICK_MOVE is followed by fresh server slot confirmation before another click. Unexpected item/component/slot changes stop the batch without blind retry; confirmed prefix and any unconfirmed final click are reported separately. Optional routing_label is rechecked before both opens and every transfer click. Reserve 600+60*(max_stacks-1) ticks, 50 times that in ms, 360 camera degrees, and 2+max_stacks interactions. The bounded container attempt uses 400+60*(max_stacks-1) ticks, leaving 200 ticks for Action dispatch/JIT/release. Opening always uses MAIN_HAND and prefers a nonempty hotbar item whose NeoForge doesSneakBypassUse and onItemUseFirst implementations are the unchanged IItemExtension defaults false and PASS. An empty hotbar slot is used only when the offhand doesSneakBypassUse hook is also unchanged; an empty offhand is allowed. On the exact normal-use vanilla container, useWithoutItem returns a consuming result before ItemStack.useOn can run, so ordinary block items, tools and stack components alone remain safe. A cobblestone stack left by an earlier inbound transfer can therefore open the container without another interaction. A custom MAIN_HAND hook, or a custom offhand sneak-bypass hook with an empty MAIN_HAND, is rejected; offhand is never the interaction hand. If no candidate exists, safe_open_hand=no_side_effect_free_main_hand and remedy=prepare_plain_material_or_safe_mining_tool_in_hotbar explain the remedy. Prediction admission failure reports only prediction_bridge=unregistered|disabled|lifecycle_closed|attempt_limit.

minimum_container_count.description: Absolute container lower bound, not an exact transfer amount. Whole-stack limits can leave a confirmed prefix and then fail with TRANSFER_BATCH_GOAL_NOT_REACHED.

max_transfer_count.description: Ceiling for this whole-stack batch. Stacks are never split to fill the remaining budget.

craftKnownRecipeNode.description: Craft 1..3 times from one current opaque recipe query result at one visible in-reach crafting table. Copy recipe_ref and fingerprint from the same latest agent_get_state recipe result into recipe_ref and recipe_fingerprint. The runtime revalidates both before normal menu use, supports only deterministic inventory_2x2/crafting_table recipes, and stops when the component-exact absolute inventory goal is reached. station.expected_state is the exact crafting-table state shown here; its properties object is empty. Each craft places one recipe, QUICK_MOVEs exactly one result while retaining the server-proven empty cursor, then closes/reopens for authoritative full readback. Reserve at least 30000 ms, 600 ticks, 360 camera degrees, and the conservative 1+4*max_crafts interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero.

smeltKnownRecipeNode.description: Smelt one exact full input stack of 1..64 items from one current opaque recipe query result at one visible in-reach furnace, blast furnace, or smoker. Copy recipe_ref, recipe_fingerprint, station kind, target, and complete expected_state from the same latest evidence. goal and fuel accept only default_components_only. The declared station family, recipe display kind, required screen, exact empty menu, input stack count=max_smelts, sufficient fuel stack, and QUICK_MOVE routes are revalidated before input. Planner admission and the execution-start preflight use the same delivery-backed visible-surface ray hit rather than the occludable block center; its one-way |yaw|+|pitch| aim is at most 270 degrees, and every initial/readback open still requires a live exact-target hit. The runtime QUICK_MOVEs both full source stacks, recovers remaining fuel, and closes/reopens after loading and final recovery to prove an empty station and component-exact inventory delta. Raw slots and GUI coordinates remain private. This node is the final top-level Action node and never appears inside if/repeat. Reserve 2200+200*max_smelts ticks, 50 times that many milliseconds, up to 540 camera degrees for aim plus admitted-view restoration, and 7 interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero.

operateKnownMenuNode.description: Execute exactly one current opaque operation_ref issued for the currently owned known menu. The runtime revalidates the session, Screen instance, container, state, profile, and operation immediately before dispatch. Raw slots, GUI coordinates, callbacks, and packet payloads are never accepted. This node must be the final top-level Action node and never appears inside if/repeat. Reserve at least 30000 ms, 600 ticks, and 1 interaction; distance, camera, breaks, and placements are zero.

standardPotionBatch.description: A component-exact unmodified Vanilla potion identity. When used as input, item+potion must match one own-inventory standard_potions entry whose aggregated count is at least this declared 1..3 count. expected_output instead declares the closed recipe result and need not already exist in inventory. Custom components are never accepted.

brewingIngredient.description: Closed 26.2 one-step table. Container conversions preserve potion: potion+gunpowder->splash_potion; splash_potion+dragon_breath->lingering_potion. Same-container potion transitions are water+glowstone_dust->thick, water+redstone->mundane, water+nether_wart->awkward. Each start mix has both water+ingredient->mundane and awkward+ingredient->effect: breeze_rod->wind_charged, slime_block->oozing, stone->infested, cobweb->weaving, magma_cream->fire_resistance, rabbit_foot->leaping, sugar->swiftness, glistering_melon_slice->healing, spider_eye->poison, ghast_tear->regeneration, blaze_powder->strength. Other transitions: awkward+golden_carrot->night_vision; night_vision+redstone->long_night_vision; night_vision+fermented_spider_eye->invisibility; long_night_vision+fermented_spider_eye->long_invisibility; invisibility+redstone->long_invisibility; fire_resistance+redstone->long_fire_resistance; leaping+redstone->long_leaping; leaping+glowstone_dust->strong_leaping; leaping+fermented_spider_eye->slowness; long_leaping+fermented_spider_eye->long_slowness; slowness+redstone->long_slowness; slowness+glowstone_dust->strong_slowness; awkward+turtle_helmet->turtle_master; turtle_master+redstone->long_turtle_master; turtle_master+glowstone_dust->strong_turtle_master; swiftness+fermented_spider_eye->slowness; long_swiftness+fermented_spider_eye->long_slowness; swiftness+redstone->long_swiftness; swiftness+glowstone_dust->strong_swiftness; awkward+pufferfish->water_breathing; water_breathing+redstone->long_water_breathing; healing+glowstone_dust->strong_healing; healing+fermented_spider_eye->harming; strong_healing+fermented_spider_eye->strong_harming; harming+glowstone_dust->strong_harming; poison+fermented_spider_eye->harming; long_poison+fermented_spider_eye->harming; strong_poison+fermented_spider_eye->strong_harming; poison+redstone->long_poison; poison+glowstone_dust->strong_poison; regeneration+redstone->long_regeneration; regeneration+glowstone_dust->strong_regeneration; strength+redstone->long_strength; strength+glowstone_dust->strong_strength; water+fermented_spider_eye->weakness; weakness+redstone->long_weakness; awkward+phantom_membrane->slow_falling; slow_falling+redstone->long_slow_falling. Any other tuple is rejected before input.

brewKnownPotionBatchNode.description: Brew exactly one catalog-fixed standard Vanilla one-step recipe for 1..3 equal-count potions at one current visible in-reach brewing stand. input must match a component-exact own-inventory standard_potions entry with sufficient aggregated singleton count. expected_output declares the component-exact closed recipe result and need not already exist in inventory; custom color/effects/name/lore, impossible overstacks, and arbitrary recipes are rejected. The declared transition is checked both against the closed 26.2 recipe table and the current connection's PotionBrewing.mix result. fuel_item is always blaze powder. All five stand item slots must be empty, internal brew-time must be zero, and the hidden Vanilla fuel counter must be within 0..20 at Action start. When it is already 1..20 the runtime consumes one existing fuel use and skips inventory fuel insertion; when it is zero the runtime inserts exactly one blaze powder. Therefore a blaze-powder ingredient needs one inventory powder when precharged and two when uncharged. These conditions are checked only after a normal menu open; no stand-slot or data value is exposed, and a mismatch returns a fixed replan diagnostic. Interrupted brewing cannot be resumed or replayed by this opcode, and every failure stops the unstarted suffix. This node is allowed only once as the final top-level Action node, never inside if/repeat and never with a following node. Planner admission and the execution-start preflight both use the same delivery-backed visible-surface ray hit rather than the occludable stand center and reject its one-way |yaw|+|pitch| aim above 270 degrees before normal use; every initial/readback open still requires a live exact-target hit. When needed, put face_known_position for the same visible stand immediately before this node and add that face node's own cost to the Action budget. Reserve at least 70000 ms, 1400 ticks, up to 540 camera degrees for this node's aim plus admitted-view restoration, and 16 interactions; distance, breaks, and placements are zero. While this terminal menu node owns the screen, recovery dispatches no gameplay interaction, so the published Action interaction ceiling remains 16. Execution uses normal use/menu clicks, fixed submitted intent, authoritative full-content/data progress and close/reopen readback that returns all five item slots empty and proves exactly one fuel use was consumed, then releases the screen/cursor/input owner before terminal publication.

collectVisibleItemNode.description: Collect at least one fresh visible minecraft:item matching displayed_item near the copied continuous target position. The runtime rechecks the witness while moving and selects the fastest reachable known safe pickup cell. If only that pickup cell becomes invalid while a fresh matching displayed_item witness remains within 0.75 blocks of the submitted position, it first releases input and may bind a new safe cell and known route; public records omit entity UUID and do not claim individual identity across movement or merging. The inventory baseline and effective occurrence and Action deadlines never slide. Disappearance, movement outside the matching bound, or failure to prove a safe route ends PATH_BLOCKED. Success always requires an absolute inventory-count increase relative to this node occurrence's start.

collectVisibleItemBatchNode.description: Collect 2..8 currently visible item witnesses in one fail-fast Action and preserve listed order. The batch fixes per-item absolute inventory baselines at batch start. Each active entry uses the same bounded, input-releasing pickup-cell rebind as collect_visible_item without extending its original deadline. A later target may complete as incidentally collected only after a fresh policy-visible item AABB actually intersects the player pickup area and the matching absolute inventory count subsequently increases; witness disappearance, movement, or merge alone never succeeds. Any failure stops the unstarted suffix.

castKnownFishingRodNode.description: Cast only an exact fishing rod already held in the declared hand toward a fresh delivery-backed visible face of exact source water. The current player pose and ray witness are revalidated immediately before the bounded normal item-use call; arbitrary item use is not exposed. Success requires an owned bobber to appear and returns a short-lived world-session-local fishing_session_ref in the confirmed effect ledger. The node must be the only top-level Action node. This source-water ray is a safe cast witness, not a hidden-neighborhood or treasure-quality open-water guarantee.

reelKnownFishingSessionNode.description: Consume one fresh fishing_session_ref for the exact still-owned bobber and exact held fishing rod/hand, then perform one bounded normal item-use reel. Success requires owned-bobber disappearance plus a rod-durability or aggregate inventory delta; it deliberately does not fix the caught item type. Raw key/mouse and arbitrary item use are not exposed.

operateKillZoneNode.description: The operate_kill_zone opcode is a top-level-only finite kill-zone operation. With MCP form elicitation, consent_ref:null requests client-side user approval and the accepted retry starts the same bound Action without an in-game prompt. Clients without form elicitation fall back to the local physical prompt and fresh ref flow. The scope covers current and later matching entities in the zone, never one specific entity. For sustained farms, choose an operation duration matching the requested work window (normally at least 3600 ticks, or a potion/equipment window); max_attacks and every hard safety gate may end it earlier. The initial production geometry is a strict one-cell safety enclosure: full support and roof, three full two-block walls, and a zone-facing full lower block plus exact top slab above it, leaving a half-block-height eye-to-body slit. The runtime never moves the camera; only a fresh matching LivingEntity currently under the crosshair can be attacked.

fishingSplashCondition.description: Wake on an accepted current ClientLevel position-sound event for the exact Vanilla bobber splash at or after since_tick, inside the declared finite AABB and within two blocks of the local player's currently owned bobber. This remains independent of audio-device playback. since_tick is a lower bound, not a five-second age cap; max_ticks is additionally limited to 900 so the 1200-tick fishing_session_ref remains usable.

waitUntilNode.description: At primitive start, target must be a current policy-visible wheat surface under a target-scoped fresh proof: an exact retained target mutation revision is combined with the visual barrier without being invalidated by unrelated mutation evictions; when the exact revision is absent, the global eviction floor applies fail-closed. The adopted visible_surface.eye_origin must match the current JIT observer eye within the fixed epsilon; a stale frame from a previous observer position is rejected. Authorization preserves that witness eye_origin rather than substituting the current eye, and also binds the exact world/session/dimension/target, current visual barrier, and player position. Any visual-barrier advance or observer drift beyond the epsilon terminates before BlockState is read; navigation-neutral wheat AGE updates do not advance that barrier. While the fence remains current, execution reads live BlockState only at that authorized loaded coordinate: immature wheat stays pending, mature wheat completes, and replacement, unload, or world/session change terminates fail-safe without exposing live state.

budget.description: The schema-wide 86,400,000-ms and 1,728,000-tick maxima exist only for one top-level hold_bounded_inputs node. Runtime admission retains the smaller per-op limits for every other Action. For hold_bounded_inputs, max_duration_ms and max_ticks must cover duration_ticks at 50 ms per tick; use zero movement for attack/use-only holds, one interaction for use, and one possible block break for attack.

max_distance_blocks.description: Public distance budget, capped at 32. Route search first reserves 1.5*sqrt(6) for bounded start-pose uncertainty, then charges 1.5 times centerline edge length plus 1.5 per vertical edge. A flat cardinal route is therefore at most 18 edges; routes with vertical edges are shorter.

approval_scope_summary.description: Runtime-derived, human-readable dimension, target kill-zone bounds, and player station bounds used by the approval prompt.

tools.name: agent_get_action
tools.title: Get MCMCP Action
tools.description: Returns bounded progress, a policy-filtered trace, a bounded latest-effect ring (monotonic seq; earlier entries may be evicted) with terminal aggregate, terminal partial/resume metadata, and the bounded canonical JSON source/hash for one explicit action handle. A confirmed effect has server-derived before/after evidence; unknown means a mutation was dispatched without a confirmed after-state and requires reobservation, never blind replay. source is audit data, not replay authority. template is identical only when no opaque reference exists; otherwise every opaque ref and its coupled recipe fingerprint are null, ready_for_agent_start_action=false, and reference_requirements says how to refresh them. Opaque refs are never declared live by this off-client-thread read and must always be refreshed before cloning. wait_timeout_ms is an optional integer from 0 through 25000; zero or omission returns immediately, otherwise it waits off the Minecraft client thread until terminal or timeout. Set include_container_results=true to return complete item-ID totals from successful inspect_known_container nodes (up to 54 types per container, component differences aggregated). container_results_limit is 1..8 (default 4); pass next_cursor as container_results_cursor with include_container_results=true for more containers. Cursors freeze a result-count snapshot and are bound to action_id. Each result is immutable server-synchronized evidence published only after owned-menu cleanup; observed_client_tick and packet_revision describe the captured server snapshot, not present inventory or mutation authority. total_item_types, returned_item_types and truncated explicitly report completeness. All successful inspection occurrences (max 256 expanded nodes) are retained without eviction while the Action is retained; the store retains only the latest Action and previous terminal Action. Read all pages before starting further Actions. A missing result is not an empty chest; failed/unconfirmed inspections have no result. An empty verified chest has a result with items=[] and total_item_types=0. During execution, query again without a cursor for newly completed results. trace remains a short, possibly truncated summary; use container_results for complete inventories. Omission/false preserves the legacy output without container_results. Page-only arguments require the option to be true.

wait_timeout_ms.description: Optional bounded terminal-state long poll. Zero or omission returns immediately; a non-terminal timeout returns the current snapshot with the unchanged output shape.

include_container_results.description: Return a page of complete immutable inspection results; omitted/false keeps the legacy output.

container_results_limit.description: Maximum containers per page; requires include_container_results=true.

container_results_cursor.description: Use next_cursor from the same action_id; requires include_container_results=true.

effectObservation.description: Bounded semantic observation only; raw menu slots, payloads, credentials, and secrets are never present.

displayed_item.description: Server-observed frame item; minecraft:air means a confirmed empty display. Omitted means unknown.

recoverable.description: True means fresh observation and replanning may recover. It never authorizes blind replay of the original Action.

effects.description: Bounded latest-effect ring recorded at authoritative observation/ACK points. Sequence numbers remain monotonic when earlier entries are evicted. An unknown entry means a mutation was dispatched but its after-state was not confirmed; it must never be replayed blindly.

verification.description: Independent of terminal state. A confirmed effect remains committed even when the Action later fails or is cancelled and must be applied exactly once.

effect_aggregate.description: Fixed-size lifetime aggregate that remains complete when older effect-ring entries are evicted.

partial.description: Null while non-terminal. Every terminal result carries bounded interruption/resume metadata derived from the live ledger, never reconstructed after completion.

has_confirmed_effects.description: True when this terminal Action has one or more committed confirmed effects, including failed or cancelled Actions.

resume_requires_reobservation.description: When true, obtain fresh state or observation and plan a new Action. Do this even when every retained effect is confirmed; never replay the original Action blindly.

source.description: Canonical normalized Action DSL accepted for this action. It contains only caller-submitted, parser-recognized fields and never reflects secrets, hidden state, raw slots, or runtime-only data.

replayable.description: False whenever the retained source contains any opaque reference; use the redacted template and refresh every reference instead.

template.description: Safe clone template. Any opaque references and coupled recipe fingerprint are JSON null until replaced from a fresh producer result, making the template intentionally invalid for agent_start_action while blocked.

tools.name: agent_cancel_action
tools.title: Cancel MCMCP Action
tools.description: Idempotently requests cancellation of one explicit action handle.
